articles.title: Forget the Main Anime—Pokémon’s YouTube Shorts Are Where the Magic Happens
articles.summary: “Dragonite and the Special Delivery,” a stunning 15-minute animated short, just got an English dub. It follows Hana, a postal worker inspired by a delivery Dragonite, as she solves a letter mystery. The short is packed with heart, gorgeous flight sequences, and tiny world-building moments.

articles.title: Pocket-Sized and Rugged: Celestron Outland X 10x25 Binoculars Are a Kid’s Perfect Adventure Sidekick
articles.summary: At around $50, the Celestron Outland X 10x25 binoculars are waterproof, fog-proof, and light enough to forget in your pocket. They’re ideal for casual wildlife watching, but expect some purple color fringing and a hazy image—especially if you wear glasses.

articles.title: Taiwan’s Janet Chen Brings Breaststroke Power to Fresno State—and She’s Just Getting Started
articles.summary: World Junior Championships qualifier Janet Chen will cross the Pacific to join Fresno State’s swim team in fall 2026. The breaststroke and freestyle specialist has been on a personal-best tear, and her converted times could score points immediately in the Mountain West Conference.
